messages:
maria g: Heads-up: planning a fragmented maintenance window for EU-west serving nodes next Tue 00:30-02:30 UTC. Want to avoid full-region drain — we'll do AZ-by-AZ restarts with staggered customer notification. cc @devon @samir :calendar: 

samir khan: +1. Can you post the customer-facing copy draft here? Also confirm whether Dedicated tenants get separate notice.

maria g: Draft below. Dedicated will be notified separately via account team; we'll include a note about SLA-covered capacity. Template first, then per-AZ timing.

maria g: (customer notice draft)
Hi --
We will be performing scheduled maintenance in EU-west to apply security patches and rotate kernel images. The work will be carried out in a staggered fashion to minimize disruption: each availability zone will be briefly drained and restarted for up to 10 minutes, with a rolling approach across AZs. Expected overall window: Tue 00:30-02:30 UTC. Impact: short, transient request requeues and model fallback may occur for up to ~10 minutes per AZ. No data loss expected. If you have dedicated capacity, your account manager will reach out with specifics.

If you have traffic around that period and want us to postpone or coordinate, reply to this email or open a support ticket.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations

maria g: Thoughts?

devon t: Looks good. Add a short bit about status page updates and where we'll post live signal: status.redwood.ai -> "Scheduled maintenance" then per-AZ progress messages.

maria g: added. Updated draft below with status page link and expected per-AZ window.

maria g: (updated customer notice)
Hi --
We will be performing scheduled maintenance in EU-west to apply security patches and rotate kernel images. The work will be carried out in a staggered fashion to minimize disruption: each availability zone will be briefly drained and restarted for up to 10 minutes, with a rolling approach across AZs. Expected overall window: Tue 00:30-02:30 UTC. Impact: short, transient request requeues and model fallback may occur for up to ~10 minutes per AZ. We will post per-AZ progress updates on our status page: https://status.redwood.ai.

If you have traffic during this period and want us to coordinate, reply to this email or open a support ticket. Dedicated customers: your account manager will reach out with tailored timing.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations

elaine_ng: Small suggestion: add a note about how to interpret "model fallback" in case they see quality differences (e.g., we might fallback to a slightly smaller instance during the restart).

maria g: good call. added short explainer.

chris_l: Ops checklist for oncall: 
- Pre-notify customers via support broadcast (now + 24h + 1h)
- Create status page incident with scheduled maintenance type
- Configure routing policy to prefer other regions for affected endpoints if latency budget allows
- Enable extended logs for 30m around each AZ drain
- Pager escalation: primary -> secondary after 8m -> infra-lead after 15m

maria g: I'll run the pre-notify tonight (now) and schedule automated follow-ups. Can whoever is primary on Tue AT START contact ops-bot to trigger the maintenance workflow? ops-bot will create the status page entry and run the drain script.

ops-bot: scheduled-maintenance workflow created: id=mm-2234567890. Status page draft URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/mm-2234567890. Use `ops-bot trigger mm-2234567890` to start.

devon t: I'm primary then. I'll be online at start time. Quick checklist for me: confirm canary AZ, confirm fallback model variant list, confirm rollback play.

samir khan: For Dedicated tenants, who handles manual exemption requests? Support or account team?

support_bot: Dedicated-tier exemption requests: route to accounts@redwood.ai and tag `dedicated-exemptions`. Support will escalate to oncall if response required.

maria g: Logging the rollback play here in case we need to revert: 
1) Pause drain on next AZ 
2) Re-enable routing to pre-maint instances 
3) Re-queue any pending requests with `x-redwood-retry: 3` header to reduce client impact 
4) Open urgent ticket to infra for kernel rollback

chris_l: Also: telemetry owner — set a brief eval check after each AZ: sample 100 requests for latency and output-diffs. If output-diff rate > 5% vs baseline, roll back and notify product.

elaine_ng: Can someone add a small customer snippet we can paste into status page updates? Short, non-technical.

maria g: Status page snippets below (one-liners).
1) Scheduled: "We are performing brief, staggered maintenance in EU-west. You may see short transient errors as nodes restart. No data loss expected."
2) In progress (AZ1): "Maintenance in EU-west AZ-a is in progress. Affected requests may experience brief delays or fallbacks."
3) In progress (AZ2): "Maintenance in EU-west AZ-b is in progress..."
4) Complete: "Maintenance complete in EU-west. All systems returning to normal."

devon t: Nice. I'll post per-AZ progress and attach the small telemetry snapshot after each AZ.

maria g: On handoff: devon you'll take initial pager. After 60 minutes from start, samir will take secondary for oversight. If escalation needed, page infra-lead. I'll be watching the status page and coordinating comms with support.

samir khan: I'll be available during the afternoon window for follow-ups. If Dedicated customers ask for a hard pause, we'll coordinate timelines with the account team.

devon t: Ops-bot, please remind on-call at T-minus 15 minutes and T-minus 1 minute.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: on-call notification in 15 minutes (id=rem-2234567890-15m) and 1 minute (id=rem-2234567890-1m).

samir khan: One more: let's include a short internal template for support responders in case customers ping. Support script: 
"Thanks — we're performing scheduled maintenance in EU-west in a rolling, per-AZ manner. You may see brief errors; we expect any single AZ to be impacted for up to 10 minutes. We've posted live updates here: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/mm-2234567890. If you'd like us to coordinate timing, please reply and we'll escalate to your account manager"

maria g: Perfect. I'll push the initial pre-notify now and attach the support script and the customer notice.

support_bot: Broadcast queued to customer segment: "EU-west active projects". Email outbound in 1 minute.

maria g: broadcast sent. Also scheduled follow-up reminders at 24h and 1h.

devon t: Quick quick: if we see degraded throughput > 15% during an AZ, we'll pause and revert routing. Agree?

chris_l: +1. We'll auto-trigger rollback if latency P95 increases > 200ms for > 5 minutes paired with throughput dip.

maria g: Thanks all. Post-maint communications: I'll send a completion note and close the status page incident once telemetry looks stable for 30 minutes. Please call out any customer-reported anomalies in this thread after the window.

ops-bot: maintenance mm-2234567890 scheduled successfully. Good luck :rocket: 

support_bot: Customer email sent to 312 recipients in segment.

maria g: Leaving this pinned. devon, ping here when you `ops-bot trigger mm-2234567890` at start time so we have the live thread.

devon t: Will do. 

maria g: (end of preflight)
